div.div:
Open-Drain Requires Pull-Up
Using Open-Drain on both sides avoid contention.
But we also don't want the line to be floating,
-> attach an external pull up
but we don't want to create a short (external pull up -> device pull down)
-> put a resistor on the pull up path

div.div:
What is arbitration?
When 2 masters try to drive the line at the same time.
Per the design of open-drain, if one side is driving low, then the line is low.
So in cases of arbitration, the side that tries to send a HIGH would notice that it's sending a HIGH but reading a LOW, meaning:
- Someone may also be controlling the line

div.div:
If it push-pull encounters arbitration, it would result in short.
So while open-drain arbitrations are problematic, they don't destroy the circuit
